Most investors assume a silver ETF gets taxed like a stock fund. The IRS disagrees. SLV and PSLV are classified as collectibles under Section 408(m), so long-term gains face a 28% maximum rate, not 20%. And SLV charges 0.50% annually by reducing the silver per share each year. Physical silver in a home safe: $0 in annual fees.
